item.title: US AI chip curbs threaten Southeast Asia data centre boom, shares slump
item.description: The new rule restricts shipments of advanced chips to the region's major economies such as Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, which some Chinese companies have used to access computing power to train AI models. It also imposes new requirements on overseas data centres that supply "significant volumes of computing power" to firms headquartered in China.

item.title: Samsung Electronics, TSMC shares fall after US announces curbs on China's chip access
item.description: Shares of Samsung Electronics and TSMC lost ground on Tuesday in Asia after the Trump administration said on Monday it would further restrict China's access to advanced AI chips.

item.title: Anthropic debuts to skeptics and dogged believers: Mike Dolan
item.description: The Claude developer's bumper initial public offering (IPO) is set to price on Wednesday before trading begins the following day. In the rush to go public before rival ChatGPT owner OpenAI, it has been caught in a volatility storm that's seen some $2 trillion wiped off AI chip giant and ubiquitous AI financier Nvidia's market value in just six weeks.
